claim.excerpt: Diazepam is primarily metabolized by cytochrome P450 2C19 (CYP2C19) or cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) to form nordiazepam or temazepam, which are subsequently converted to oxazepam via hydroxylation or demethylation.
